policies.print_translation: Each physical face declares one dominant reading mechanism. Supporting devices may reinforce it but cannot compete for first attention.

source_references.rationale: Defines one primary emphasis and ordered hierarchy.
Defines balance, rhythm, and competing-weight failure modes.

known_exceptions: A deliberate A3 comparison may contain two equal panels when the comparison itself is the single mechanism.

policies.print_translation: A family is selectable only after every required region fits real German copy, item count, image ratio, font, and line limits.

source_references.rationale: Separates primary content from noise and identifies over-compression.
Requires minimum and maximum content scenarios and character limits.

known_exceptions: Display-only faces use element-specific capacity rather than body-copy word limits.

policies.print_translation: Color, spacing, typography, rules, and recurring geometry come from versioned print tokens. Family CSS cannot introduce unexplained one-off values.

source_references.rationale: Requires semantic token layers and forbids raw component values.
Provides structural hierarchy and consistency principles.

known_exceptions: A new value may enter only through a versioned token proposal with atlas or client evidence.

policies.print_translation: Sustained body columns target 45 to 75 characters per line, adjusted for the actual typeface and point size, while labels and display lines are exempt.

source_references.rationale: Defines the measurable body-copy range and exemptions.
Adds typeface-aware measure and reading rhythm.

known_exceptions: Narrow evidence rails, captions, tables, and short display statements use their own role-specific measures.

policies.print_translation: Internal, related, sectional, and page-edge spacing use named tiers. Repeated elements share gaps, while larger separation signals a new semantic group.

source_references.rationale: Defines proximity, inner versus outer spacing, and vertical rhythm.
Defines named spacing tiers and density modes.

known_exceptions: Intentional grid-breaking emphasis still aligns to a documented anchor and cannot create accidental orphan spacing.

policies.print_translation: Static charts use the simplest form that matches the relationship, preserve zero baselines for bars, label values directly, and never rely on color alone.

source_references.rationale: Defines chart choice, zero baselines, direct labels, and color-safe encoding.
Requires measured contrast and redundant semantic cues.

known_exceptions: A decorative numeric statement with no encoded quantitative comparison is not treated as a chart.

policies.print_translation: Every visual-review finding states an observable page fact, the reader-facing failure, and an owner-addressed remediation rather than an aesthetic adjective alone.

source_references.rationale: Defines observation, problem, and fix critique structure.
Defines documented review gates and objective checklists.

known_exceptions: Blind preference scores may be recorded without remediation, but cannot alone create a deterministic failure.

policies.print_translation: Reviewers assess whether dark mass, imagery, dense copy, and whitespace form an intentional center of gravity on each face.

source_references.rationale: Names visual mass, center of gravity, whitespace, and rhythm.
Supplies general editorial grid and hierarchy guidance.

known_exceptions: No numeric mass threshold is calibrated yet, so this remains a blind human score.
